name: Flind Fighter 2
body:
Flind Fighter 2
CR 3

XP 800
Male flind fighter 2
CE Medium humanoid (gnoll)
Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +3

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 11, flat-footed 17 (+6 armor, +1 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 40 (2d8+2d10+20)
Fort +11, Ref +1, Will -1 (+0 vs. fear)

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee flindbar +10 (1d8*+5)
Ranged dagger +4 (1d4+5/19–20)

(*The original text indicated 1d6 damage but the flindbar as defined in Monster Codex deals 1d8 damage or 1d6 vs. small opponents.)

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 12, Con 20, Int 13, Wis 8, Cha 12
Base Atk +3; CMB +8 (+10 disarm); CMD 19
Feats Combat Expertise, Improved Disarm, Quick Draw, Weapon Focus (flindbar)
Skills Intimidate +8, Perception +3, Survival +6
Languages Gnoll
SQ bravery +1
Combat Gear p otion of cure moderate wounds, potion of expeditious retreat; Other Gear masterwork breastplate, masterwork flindbar, 5 daggers, ring of feather falling
